availability_audit: Every member's pool-48 entry was checked for gate and source map. Metagross, Excadrill, Incineroar, Amoonguss and Togekiss are evolution-gated lines whose windows (24-48) all open at or before this battle; Salamence is wild in Meteor Falls B1F back room, which the fresh run reaches before the Fortree stretch. No AshenWoods/gate-48 legendary-sign species and no legendaries at all are used. For the Route 103 Surf-backtrack trio the battle is reached AFTER Norman, so the player legitimately holds the full cap-48 inventory; nothing here is sourced from a map later than Route 115-119. Free Center held-item catalogue supplies the ordinary items; Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly.
plan: Crack line: deny a useful Ditto target, shut down the utility fish, keep an answer to Mega Gyarados. Amoonguss is deliberately placed in the slot Imposter Ditto copies - a Choice Scarf Amoonguss is locked into one support move and is the least useful thing on this party to be copied - and its Spore then answers the copy. Rillaboom is brought in specifically for this fight: Grassy Surge makes Grassy Glide a priority move, which beats a Choice Scarf Ditto regardless of Speed, and Grass is 2x into Milotic, Feebas, Magikarp and Mega Gyarados alike. Salamence is dropped for this battle because Milotic's Ice Beam is 4x into it.
